notes: Three branches marked by «ح» (and a «وحدثنا» for the third), each with its own names, converge at «جميعا عن عبد الرحمن بن الأسود»: that name, «عن أبيه» and Aisha are written once and so belong to every branch (shared_tail)
«أبيه» after «عبد الرحمن بن الأسود» is a bare kin term (relation); Aisha speaks her own words and is the last link
